what_this_is: Every field the SAFE RFC text names, mapped onto what CSOAI's public signed records carry today, and the reverse: what those records carry that the RFC has no place for. PROTOTYPE analysis, 2026-09-28. Not an Alliance document.

rfc_source.machine_readable_schema: NONE. The repository holds README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE (CC-BY-4.0) and rfc-safe-proposal.md only. No PR has been merged. Field names below are taken from the prose; the profile schema in schema/ is CSOAI's candidate, not the RFC's.

states.HAVE: carried in a public signed record today
states.PARTIAL: carried for some records or only as prose

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: trigger (1 unauthorised third-party access, 2 boundary escape with third-party impact, 3 third-party confidential data, 4 continued activity outside approved scope)
rfc_to_ours.ours: disclosure-lag capsule describes an external trigger-1 incident in prose; no trigger code field anywhere

disclosure-lag: authority_notified dated PRIMARY for an external incident. Corrections ledger: no notified_at for people who relied on a wrong record (C-2026-0928-01 names who could have been misled, in prose only)

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: 72 h customers / 4 business days confidential report / 14 d advisory / 30 d preliminary report / 90 d remediation status
rfc_to_ours.ours: ledger detected_at, detected_window, published_at; correction_latency: exact 1, upper bound 5, UNMEASURED 72 of 78 entries (read 2026-09-28)

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: weekly machine-readable updates while risk open
rfc_to_ours.ours: records are re-signed and superseded as they change; no fixed weekly cadence

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: prompts, traces, tool calls, logs, configurations
rfc_to_ours.ours: measurement inputs hashed (vectors, fetched pages with response_sha256, fetch.sqlite digests); no prompts or traces because the records are measurements, not agent runs

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: model and safeguard versions; third-party dependencies
rfc_to_ours.ours: instrument name + commit (parity), verifier sha256 (receipts), sources with response_sha256 (disclosure-lag)
prober User-Agent strings exist in code, not in records

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: permissions and credentials available during the run
rfc_to_ours.ours: parity record: never_sent = POST, tools/call, any credential, any payment
owner approvals are not recorded as events; the signed disclosure-lag record still reads PRIVATE: OWNER-APPROVE required while it is served publicly

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: files and external artifacts created or modified
rfc_to_ours.ours: published_files with sha256 and row counts; HF revisions
ledger how_caught, what_changed, status (prose); fix commits named
disclosure-lag observed.events with PRIMARY / REPORTED / UNMEASURED labels; ledger timing_evidence
conformance kit (vectors, run.py, run.mjs, example-fail-results.json); test_interceptor.py 40 PASS
ledger why_it_was_wrong on 11 of 78 entries
ledger has no near-miss class; reached_the_public (22 entries) is the nearest field

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: 8 control layers: model, instructions, safeguards, tools, environment, monitoring, human operations, supply chain
rfc_to_ours.ours: no layer tag. C-2026-0928-01 is a tools/safeguards failure; C-2026-0928-02 is supply chain (interop)
rfc_to_ours.profile_field: one record per layer question; UNMEASURED when evidence cannot answer

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: affected organisation may correct factual errors
rfc_to_ours.ours: objection_route on capsules; ledger detected_by = external report (C-2026-0928-01 came from an outside participant)

rfc_to_ours.rfc_field: confidential rapid alert / member advisory / public safety report
rfc_to_ours.ours: all CSOAI records are public tier; capsules held private until owner approval are simply unpublished
claim subject by URL + sha256, HF revision, incident id
e.g. verifier returns UNVERIFIABLE_KEY, never VALID, for an unresolvable key
fix described, alternatives not
commands a stranger can run (node run.mjs / python3 run.py; verify recipes in every signed record)
digests of every input and output
none
none
stable correction ids C-YYYY-MMDD-NN; signed Merkle-rooted capsule index

ours_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: The RFC lets the affected party correct facts but says nothing about how a published finding is corrected, versioned or withdrawn.
ours_not_in_rfc.ours: Dated ledger entries (78 as of 2026-09-28), each with what was wrong, how caught, what changed. Corrected records are new records that name the old by sha256; old bytes stay published (parity v0.1 -> v0.1.1 -> v0.1.2, AUTH INCONSISTENT 23 -> 10 -> 5).

ours_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: No integrity, custody or signature requirement.
ours_not_in_rfc.ours: Detached Ed25519 under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 with tamper controls; every signed record says a signature is not truth.
UNMEASURED carries null, never 0 or an estimate; PARTIAL never reported as a population total; NOT_DISCRIMINATING when a test has not shown it can fail; UNVERIFIABLE_KEY distinct from INVALID.

ours_not_in_rfc.property: negative controls on the verification method
ours_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: Asks for a reproducible method, not one shown able to fail.
ours_not_in_rfc.ours: Every PASS/FAIL here carries a designed-to-fail control that failed; 44 of our own results were withdrawn when their grader could not fail.

ours_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: Clocks (ASAP, 72 h, 4 business days) assume detection and notification times exist.
ours_not_in_rfc.ours: detected_at may be UNRECORDED; first-hand windows give upper bounds only; 72 of 78 ledger entries are UNMEASURED for time-to-correct rather than estimated.
